They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. A tall hedge surrounds the garden.

Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The experience taught Nina more than any book could. Mia always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Also, my friend Wo paints beautiful pictures of horses.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The family dinner has become an important part of daily life. Nina keeps a small rabbit at home and feeds it every morning. The diner serves soul food on Sundays.

On Tuesday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. Nina prefers rainy weather when running in the bookstore. People around Nina often share different ideas about the old photo album. She spread butter on the toast.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Nina's dream job is to be a nurse. Nina thanked Mia for the honest advice.
